description: This Rust source file implements subscription handling for Google Workspace events, including configuration parsing, validation, Pub/Sub resource management, and event polling.

classes.name: SubscribeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for subscribing to Google Workspace events, with options for target, event types, project, subscription, message limits, polling interval, and output directory.

methods.name: parse_subscribe_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a SubscribeConfig, validating required fields.

methods.name: validate_subscribe_config
methods.description: Validates the SubscribeConfig for required fields based on subscription presence.

methods.name: handle_subscribe
methods.description: Main async function to handle the subscribe command, managing Pub/Sub resources, event polling, and cleanup.

methods.name: pull_loop
methods.description: Continuously pulls messages from Pub/Sub, processes events, writes to output directory or stdout, and handles acknowledgments.

methods.name: process_events_pull_response
methods.description: Processes Pub/Sub pull response, extracting acknowledgment IDs and decoding CloudEvents.

methods.name: decode_cloud_event
methods.description: Decodes a Pub/Sub message into a CloudEvent JSON object, decoding base64 data and extracting attributes.

methods.name: derive_slug_from_event_types
methods.description: Generates a resource-friendly slug from event types for naming Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions.
